Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "we're doing the ventilation check in the east workshop before the afternoon class and i think the fan has been louder since the filter was changed last week. start at the rear extraction hood, and please make sure the class benches are clear before anyone switches it on. put the electrician down to check the airflow at the hood, no, make that the maintenance tech, because mina is already on site and has the meter. we need a reading with the door closed and another with the loading door partly open. write both numbers on the paper log by the control panel, and note whether the fan is on the low or high setting. if the airflow seems uneven, check the grille above the paint cabinet too, but don't move any of the stored cans. i haven't checked whether the replacement filter is the same size as the old one, so just record the label if it's easy to see. then tell me if the room still smells musty after the fan has run for ten minutes. we don't need to take the unit apart today. leave the switch in its current position when you're finished, and let me know if the meter gives a reading that jumps around.", "output": "We're doing the ventilation check in the east workshop before the afternoon class, and I think the fan has been louder since the filter was changed last week. Start at the rear extraction hood, and please make sure the class benches are clear before anyone switches it on. Put the maintenance tech down to check the airflow at the hood, because Mina is already on site and has the meter. We need a reading with the door closed and another with the loading door partly open. Write both numbers on the paper log by the control panel, and note whether the fan is on the low or high setting. If the airflow seems uneven, check the grille above the paint cabinet too, but don't move any of the stored cans. I haven't checked whether the replacement filter is the same size as the old one, so just record the label if it's easy to see. Then tell me if the room still smells musty after the fan has run for ten minutes. We don't need to take the unit apart today. Leave the switch in its current position when you're finished, and let me know if the meter gives a reading that jumps around."}]
